summary: B4 UI: DONE, verified in the editor (EditMode, PlayMode) and in built Windows players with DevShot (screenshots looked at, FR and EN). Everything is code-built uGUI (contract 15.1): one Screen Space Overlay canvas per screen (CanvasScaler 1080x1920 match 0.5, GraphicRaycaster, CanvasGroup, SafeArea child), an EventSystem with InputSystemUIInputModule (navigation events off), uGUI Text with the OFL font Nunito ExtraBold (titles in Nunito Black) loaded from Resources/Fonts with the LegacyRuntime.ttf fallback, navy text shadows (#151D38, alpha 0.7, 3 px), raycastTarget only on Selectables (asserted by a test), every Selectable with navigation None and deselected after a click (arrows and Space never drive buttons). Screens are plain C# classes driven by UiRoot.LateUpdate ([DefaultExecutionOrder(300)], after the camera) and shown or hidden only by toggling Canvas.enabled and CanvasGroup alpha/interactable/blocksRaycasts, with a 0.16 s fade; every screen ticks in its own try/catch (logged once). MENU (15.2): glossy coral title (layered highlight and navy shadow), 4 round paint-drop swatches bound to Palette.HumanColor, a rimmed JOUER pill in the human color (stays readable over an attract puddle of the same color), Options, the best line 'Meilleur : 34 % · 5 victoires', soft navy gradients over the attract match. OPTIONS: Son / Vibrations / Bonus lasso switches (lasso default OFF, saved), Langue FR/EN, Qualite Auto/Haute/Moyenne/Basse (SaveData.Quality), version label; 5 taps within 1.5 s reveal 'Reglages de test' (Vitesse etincelle 1,4..2,4 step 0,1, Duree de manche 60/90/120, Delai anneau 10..30 step 5, Reinitialiser); the panel fits the safe area by width and height; closing flushes SaveData. HUD (15.3, mirrors the reference): human area in the human color left, countdown light center (full round time while the ready gate waits), best alive rival in its color right; one decimal below 10 % ('3,4 %', EN '3.4%'); the human label counts up over LiquidRenderer.FillDuration on the sim render clock (the clock of B1's fill wave, so it slows with slow motion and stops in pause) and pops 1.15 for 0.2 s; '+2,1 %' rises 0.8 s from the return point for each capture >= 0.1 % (lightened human color with a navy outline, readable over its own puddle); the timer pulses red in the last 10 s; round 'II' pause button 96 px at 60 % opacity under the area label (hidden when pausing is refused: death beat, round end); the rival label is a Button toggling a 4-row leaderboard (rank from Sim.RankOf, name, area or 'elimine', human row highlighted); toasts 1.6 s, one at a time, queue of 2 (oldest queued dropped), entries older than 3 s dropped, only toasts about the human while the human has a spark (a non-human toast on screen is cut short); a toast wider than the safe area is scaled down to fit, and with the leaderboard open it moves left of it; danger vignette = a thin 9-sliced red/white edge glow pulsing faster as SparkCatchEta drops. TUTORIAL (15.4): step 0 hint 'Glisse ton doigt pour diriger' with a code-built hand tracing an arc in the lower third (first 3 rounds, while AwaitingStart, hides on Begin); step 1 'Sors de ta couleur...' until the first capture; step 2 first cut with a pointer (pulsing ring + leader line from the nearest bubble edge) on the retraction front, or on B2's SparkEdgeIndicator when the front is off screen (read by reflection: static IsVisible / ScreenPosition), hidden on elimination or return, TutCutDone after a chased return or 2.5 s real time on screen; step 3 lasso bubble on the first pickup only (no 'Lasso pret !' toast that time). Flags are persisted only by real rounds (CountsForStats) outside batch mode. RESULTS (15.5): reads GameDirector.LastOutcome only; big rank ('1er', 'Ex aequo 1er', EN '1st', 'Tied 1st'), final area + 'surface finale', the cause line (caught by whom and at what distance, territory lost, time up, last survivor, all eliminated) and the WHY line (saved margin, or 'Elimines au meme instant' after a shared elimination), the stats line '7 captures · 2 coupes · 1 elimination · 1 poche · 1:12', the 'reglages modifies' tag (TuningModified or a command-line override), REJOUER / MENU with a 0.5 s input guard. PAUSE and QUIT (15.7): navy dim 60 %, Pause, REPRENDRE / RECOMMENCER / MENU, Son and Vibrations switches; 'Quitter ?' OUI (Application.Quit) / NON. Escape / Android back in Menu: UiRoot.HandleBack (closes Options, else toggles the quit panel), deduplicated per frame with B3's SteeringInput call. STRINGS (15.6): full FR and EN tables (80 keys, every visible text including the 15.6 keys, names Toi/Corail/Lagon/Safran/Lilas), culture-independent formatters (Decimal, Area, Gain, Clock, Duration, Count with French singular for 0 and 1, Rank, PlayerName). Contract v1.4 (section 24, the user's rule change landed mid-wave) is applied to the UI: first-cut line 'On a coupe ton trait ! Rentre avant l'etincelle pour rester en vie.', saved lines 'Rentre 0,4 s avant l'etincelle : boucle perdue.' / 'Sauve de justesse : boucle perdue.' (EN given by the contract), and no '+x %' on a saved return (its Cells are empty). Sounds: every button click calls B5's Sfx.PlayUiClick and every toast Sfx.PlayToastTick. VERIFICATION: Builder.SetupAndCompile PASS. EditMode UiStringsTests 9/9 in Unity with the final code and the v1.4 strings (TestResults/B4_edit_ui.xml). Filtered EditMode run (UiStringsTests|RuntimeSkeletonTests|S4Display|DemoScenario): 22 tests, 20 pass; the 2 DemoScenarioTests fail only because of the v1.4 Core change (see open_issues); the same run was 22/22 before v1.4. PlayMode 7 tests: Boot_MenuThenRoundRuns (now running its UI text checks on menu and HUD) and the 4 SteeringInput tests pass; Results_Demo fails only on its 'one capturing return' assertion, again v1.4 (it was 7/7 before v1.4). Final Windows build Build/B4 + DevShot (540x960, TestResults/B4_devshot_v14): menu, the HUD in every checkpoint, the v1.4 first-cut bubble with its pointer ring on the front, the v1.4 saved toast fitting the screen with no '+x %', results after Caught ('4e', '1,0 %', caught line, '0 capture · 0 coupe · 0 élimination · 1 poche · 0:10'). Earlier runs on Build/B4 covered the gain text, the leaderboard, the Options panel in FR and EN, the quit and pause panels and the step-0 hand (dev flag -uidemo). Every player log is free of exceptions, UI errors and font fallback warnings. I looked at every PNG next to docs/reference_gouttes.png: the HUD reads like the reference ('28 %  00:37  24 %' layout, colors and weight).

Format keys 'fmt.decimal', 'fmt.percent', 'fmt.gain' live in the tables. A missing key logs one warning and falls back to French, then the key.

Command line (player, dev aids, harmless otherwise): '-lang fr|en' overrides the language for the session without saving (the Options toggle clears it); '-uidemo options,quit,pause,board,hint' forces those screens visible for DevShot screenshots (visual only: the pause overlay does not pause; never used by the game).
contract_issues: Contract v1.4 (section 24) changed La Revanche while this package was being built: a saved chased return captures nothing. Applied to the UI (first-cut tutorial line, saved toast and WHY lines, no '+x %' on a saved return). Note for the contract owner: section 15.4 and 15.5 still quote the old lines ('...pour sauver ta boucle.', 'Rentre 0,4 s avant l'etincelle !', 'Sauve de justesse !'); section 24 overrides them and the code follows 24.

15.1 'every non-interactive Graphic has raycastTarget = false': applied to the modal dims too (Results, Options, Pause, Quit dims and the Options panel background are not raycast targets). Modals do not need them: the menu canvas is made non-interactable while Options or Quit is open and the HUD pause button hides while paused. Reading: only Selectables are raycast targets (asserted by UiStringsTests.UiRoot_FollowsTheUguiRules).

15.4 step 1 says 'First round, after Begin ... until the first capture'. Combined with 'never repeat a step whose flag is set', it shows after Begin in every real round while TutExitDone is false (so a player who never captured in round 1 sees it again). With v1.4 a saved chased return does not count as a capture.

Tutorial flags are written only by sessions with CountsForStats (real rounds) and never in batch mode, so DevShot, probe and PlayMode test runs never change the player's saved progress (GameDirector's own stats rule is unchanged).

15.3 toast queue: 'the queue holds 2' is applied by dropping the OLDEST queued entry when a third arrives (newest information wins). 'Toasts about the human' while chased = the human is the subject (cut dealt, spark kill, saved line, lasso ready) or the Other of a TerritoryLost elimination; non-human toasts arriving during a chase are dropped and one already on screen is cut short.

French texts use the typographic apostrophe (’) everywhere, as in the brief's tutorial lines; the contract writes a straight apostrophe. French plural rule: singular for 0 and 1 ('0 capture', '0 victoire'); English plural for 0.

Area labels: one decimal while the value rounds below 10.0 (so 9.96 shows '10 %'), whole numbers rounded to nearest above; the '+x %' gain follows the same rule. French puts a space before % ('28 %'), English none ('28%'), as in 15.3.

Results lines: eliminated human = cause line (caught: attacker + distance; or territory lost) and the WHY line 'Elimines au meme instant' when the round ended AllEliminated; alive human = time up / last survivor, and the saved line as WHY only when HadSavedReturn. Attacker names come from Strings + Palette (displayed color), not from PlayerState.Name, so they follow the current language.

open_issues: Counts: B4 added 9 EditMode tests (UiStringsTests: both tables complete, 15.6 keys, no empty value, no em dash, matching placeholders FR/EN, exact contract and brief texts, FR comma / EN point, culture independence under fr-FR/de-DE/en-US, clock/duration/plural/rank formats, results cause and WHY lines, and the 15.1 rules on a code-built UiRoot). Last filtered EditMode run: 22 tests, 20 pass (all 9 B4 tests). Last PlayMode run: 7 tests, 6 pass. The 3 failures are B0a's demo assertions broken by the v1.4 Core change, not by B4; before v1.4 the same runs were EditMode 22/22 and PlayMode 7/7. The full Core EditMode suite was not rerun by B4 (B4 touches no Core file).

DevShot's DemoScenario monitor now logs 'scenario FAIL' for the same v1.4 reason (first return captured no cell, so no LassoPocket checkpoint and no second cut): the demo needs a new script under v1.4. The UI follows the sim either way: in the v1.4 runs the saved toast shows with no '+x %', the human stays at 1,0 % and the step-1 bubble correctly persists.

Not checked on a device: safe area on a notched phone, the tap size of the 96 px pause button and the leaderboard toggle, Android back (handled by B3 + UiRoot.HandleBack), Application.Quit on Android, text crispness at high DPI.
The step-0 hand is a stylized silhouette built from rounded rectangles (no image asset); it reads as a pointing hand in the DevShot capture (B4_devshot_hint).
The caught distance shown in the demo results (11,4 m) is SparkCaught.DistanceHome as given by the sim; B4 only formats it.

The tutorial pointer computes the front itself (Trail.PointAt(RenderSparkS) projected with Camera.main) and uses B2's SparkEdgeIndicator only when the front is off screen; a reflection read means a rename by B2 silently falls back to clamping the front onto the screen edge (no error).
needs: B5: UiRoot already calls Sfx.PlayUiClick on every button click and Sfx.PlayToastTick on every toast shown. Do not also subscribe to UiRoot.ButtonClicked / ToastShown, or the sound plays twice.

B3: keep calling UiRoot.Instance.HandleBack() on Escape / back in Menu (already done; it is deduplicated per frame with UiRoot's own Escape handling). Results -> ToMenu on Escape stays B3's; UiRoot ignores an Escape that just moved Results to Menu.
B2: keep SparkEdgeIndicator.IsVisible and ScreenPosition (static, screen pixels, origin bottom left): TutorialOverlay reads them by reflection for the first-cut pointer when the front is off screen.
B1: Hud.FillDuration is LiquidRenderer.FillDuration and the count-up runs on the same render clock (Time - (1 - Alpha) Dt); keep that constant public.

B6: PlayerProbe 'all visible UI texts non-empty': idle UI texts are either disabled (Text.enabled = false) or under a CanvasGroup with alpha 0, the rule BootTests uses. UiKit.UsingFallbackFont == false proves the OFL font loaded in the player (probe check 'font not null'). The '-uidemo' and '-lang' dev flags must not be passed to the probe.

B0a / v1.4 implementer: update DemoScenario (and DemoScenarioTests, BootTests.Results_Demo) for contract 24: the demo's first return is chased, so it no longer captures, which removes the later pocket and second-cut checkpoints.

Contract owner: fold the v1.4 UI lines into 15.4 / 15.5, and record the B4 readings listed under contract_issues (modal dims not raycast targets, toast queue drops the oldest, tutorial flags not persisted by non-stats or batch sessions).
